decisions.decision_note: E002 changes PWROK and VBACKUP exposure but does not settle VRTC handling. E003 explicitly directs that VRTC remain unconnected because the board has no external RTC chip.
No later Event settles whether VBACKUP should use the reported 2.54 mm header instead of a small test pad or via, or whether the routed VRTC output should be removed to leave VRTC unconnected.
